description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
